items.name: MvPolynomial.irreducible_sumSMulX
items.type:
∀ {n : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing R] (c : n →₀ R) [IsDomain R],
  c.support.Nonempty → (∀ (r : R), (∀ (i : n), r ∣ c i) → IsUnit r) → Irreducible (MvPolynomial.sumSMulX c)

items.name: MvPolynomial.irreducible_of_forall_totalDegree_le
items.type:
∀ {k : Type u_1} {K : Type u_2} {ι : Type u_3} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : Field K] [inst_2 : Algebra k K] {a : ι → K}
  {F : MvPolynomial ι k},
  (∀ (F' : MvPolynomial ι k), F' ≠ 0 → (MvPolynomial.aeval a) F' = 0 → F.totalDegree ≤ F'.totalDegree) →
    F ≠ 0 → (MvPolynomial.aeval a) F = 0 → Irreducible F

items.name: MvPolynomial.irreducible_of_disjoint_support
items.type:
∀ {n : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing R] [IsDomain R] {f : MvPolynomial n R},
  f.support.Nontrivial →
    ∀ {d : n →₀ ℕ},
      d ∈ f.support →
        ∀ {i : n},
          d i = 1 →
            (↑f.support).PairwiseDisjoint Finsupp.support →
              (∀ (r : R), (∀ (d : n →₀ ℕ), r ∣ MvPolynomial.coeff d f) → IsUnit r) → Irreducible f

items.name: div_eq_quo_add_sum_rem_div
items.type:
∀ (R : Type u_1) [inst : CommRing R] [IsDomain R] (K : Type u_2) [inst_2 : Field K] [inst_3 : Algebra (Polynomial R) K]
  [IsFractionRing (Polynomial R) K] (f : Polynomial R) {ι : Type u_3} {g : ι → Polynomial R} {s : Finset ι},
  (∀ i ∈ s, (g i).Monic) →
    ((↑s).Pairwise fun i j => IsCoprime (g i) (g j)) →
      ∃ q r, (∀ i ∈ s, (r i).degree < (g i).degree) ∧ ↑f / ∏ i ∈ s, ↑(g i) = ↑q + ∑ i ∈ s, ↑(r i) / ↑(g i)
